messages:
Anna K.: Heads-up: Acme needs a temporary per-org routing override for a week-long showcase, want to route them to a quantized variant and bump quota. Can we make a safe, non-infra manual flow?

Chris M.: We shouldn't mutate org policies directly. My idea: ephemeral override tokens that the gateway honors when included as a header. TTL'd objects in control plane.

Devon R.: Agree. Token model: control-plane stores override obj -> {org_id, target_route, quota_delta, expires_at, fallback}. Gateway validates token and applies runtime policy. Token passed as header `X-RW-Override: <token>`.

Irina P.: Important: cache segregation. If KV/prefix caches don't include override id in the cache key, users may get responses from the non-overridden model. Gateway must include override id in cache keys.

Chris M.: Precedence: override header > org route ruleset > global defaults. Also, require override to declare model fingerprint so runtime knows which kernels/kvs to use.

Devon R.: Sample override payload we discussed in control-plane UI (pseudo-DSL):
```
id: acme-showcase-48h
org: acme
ttl: 172800
action:
  route: model:gpt-medium-4bit
  quota_delta: +1500000
  inject_header: X-RW-Override:acme-showcase-48h
fallback:
  route: model:gpt-medium-4bit-eu
  fail_mode: explicit-409
```

Anna K.: Console needs a simple flow: org -> routing -> "Create temporary override". Fields: duration, route, quota bump, justification, approver. Also show active overrides in org header with a revoke button.

ConsoleUX: Also require two things: (1) audit email to security if duration > 24h or quota_delta > 1M; (2) option to require manager approval before issuing token.

Chris M.: Telemetry: every request tagged with `override_id` in traces/logs, metrics per-override (hits, tokens-used, cost-delta), override-age histogram, and an alert if override causes >10% error delta vs baseline.

Devon R.: Operational detail: emit a cache-invalidate event on create/delete so rate-limiter and caches don't enforce stale quotas. Gateway subscribes and evicts route-specific buckets.

Irina P.: Region validation at creation time: console should check model availability in the org's preferred region and surface fallbacks. Don't allow creating an override that silently routes to an incompatible region.

oncall-bot: Note: ensure oncall playbook includes steps if override causes regen/degradation (rollback via revoke token).

deploy-bot: Created override object `acme-showcase-48h` in staging (pol_9xA2) at 1775234700. Runbook: smoke tests, cache eviction, telemetry tags.

audit-bot: Audit event: override acme-showcase-48h created by Anna K. at 1775234567, ttl 172800s, quota_delta +1500000.

Anna K.: Thanks. @Chris M. can you write the prod checklist (tests: header precedence, cache key segregation, token expiry, fallback behavior, telemetry tagging, audit event)? I'll loop in AE for justification and prod approval.
